name: Neutral (not measured)
_note: Conservative defaults for any phone that has not been measured: protective high-pass only, flat EQ, 3 dB of output headroom. Match-on-disable is off, so the S26U-tuned loudness weighting of the matcher is never used; the S26U speaker and limiter curves are not shown.
_devmode_note: Developer mode: speaker_floor_hz (graph zone below which the speaker plays practically nothing) and the bass protection threshold line protect_db_at_50 + protect_db_per_pct x (volume % - 50), at our output, 150-400 Hz, sine-equivalent dBFS. Not measured on this phone: the S26U line, shown as an estimate.
